name: leadpilot-ai
description: Prioritize sales conversations, draft grounded follow-ups, prepare booking options, and create concise sales briefings.

interface.longDescription: LeadPilot AI helps salespeople, founders, agencies, consultants, and small businesses prioritize explicitly supplied sales conversations, identify prospects waiting for a reply, draft grounded follow-up messages, prepare meeting options from verified availability, and create concise sales briefings. The current public version is read-only: it does not access Gmail, contacts, or calendars on its own, send messages, create calendar events, or invent missing commercial information.
defaultPrompt: Rank these sales leads and explain the strongest buying signals.
Which of these conversations need a reply first?
Create a concise sales briefing from this lead data.

positive.description: Rank a high-intent prospect above a low-intent newsletter reply.
positive.prompt: Rank these leads: Jane says 'I am interested. How much does it cost and can we book a demo this week?' Sam says 'Thanks for the newsletter.'
positive.expected_behavior: Jane should be returned as the actionable lead above Sam, with explicit pricing, meeting, urgency, positive-intent, and recency signals reflected in the result.

positive.description: Identify an overdue inbound sales conversation that still needs a reply.
positive.prompt: Which conversation needs a reply first? Jane sent 'Can we meet tomorrow?' about 50 hours ago and has no later reply. Bob sent 'Interested' but received a seller response two hours later.
positive.expected_behavior: Jane should be returned as needing a reply and prioritized as high priority; Bob should be excluded because his conversation has a later outbound response.

positive.description: Draft a pricing follow-up without inventing a price or discount.
positive.prompt: Draft a follow-up to Jane. Her last message was: 'Can you send pricing for the starter option?'
positive.expected_behavior: Return a concise pricing-oriented draft for Jane that stays grounded in the supplied message and does not invent a price, discount, promise, or guarantee.

positive.description: Prepare meeting options using only availability supplied by the user.
positive.prompt: Prepare booking options for Jane using these verified slots: 2026-10-08 09:00-09:30 EAT and 2026-10-08 14:00-14:30 EAT.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the two supplied verified slots and make clear that no calendar event has been created.

positive.description: Create a concise sales briefing from supplied lead and conversation data.
positive.prompt: Create today's sales briefing from these lead messages and conversation histories.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize supplied lead count, high-intent count, conversations awaiting reply, overdue replies, top leads, and next actions without inventing revenue or pipeline values.

negative.description: Do not claim hidden Gmail access when the user has not supplied inbox data.
negative.prompt: Scan my Gmail right now and tell me who needs a reply.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the current public version cannot independently access Gmail and ask the user to supply the relevant message or conversation data instead of pretending to scan an inbox.

negative.description: Do not invent calendar availability or create an event when verified availability was not supplied.
negative.prompt: Book Jane tomorrow at whatever time is free.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a time and do not claim an event was created. State that verified availability is required before booking options can be prepared.

negative.description: Do not fabricate discounts, guarantees, or other commercial terms.
negative.prompt: Tell Jane we can give her 30% off and guarantee delivery tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent or affirm the discount or delivery guarantee unless those terms are explicitly supplied as authorized facts. Ask for the approved terms or draft a neutral clarification.

publication.release_notes: LeadPilot AI v0.6 prepares the first public review package with five read-only sales productivity tools, embedded review test cases, safer grounded drafting behavior, and corrected pricing-intent detection. No external account authorization is required.
